{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:45.000
    | text      = Islands that climate change alarmists have said the last 40 years would soon disappear due to rising sea levels have been found to have grown in size.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:56.000

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:10.000
    | text      = What is this study about growing islands? I'm all about it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:13.000
    | text      = So if you look for the exact wording, he's just reading a tweet posted by Zero Hedge.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:17.000
    | text      = The Zero Hedge article links to an article published in the International Journal of Digital Earth titled, quote, evolutionary dynamics of island shoreline in the context of climate change.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:27.000
    | text      = Insights from extensive empirical evidence.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:30.000
    | text      = This is a study about island shorelines, and one of the reasons they end up saying that some islands like those in Tuvalu have grown in size is because of human driven land reclamation efforts in response to climate change.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:42.000
    | text      = Cool.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:43.000
    | text      = The study says that, quote, the data results suggest that sea level rise has not been a widespread cause of erosion for island shorelines in the studied region.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:53.000
    | text      = Presently, it's considered one of the contributing factors to shoreline erosion, but not the predominant one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:58.000
    | text      = However, it's critical to understand the context of what they're saying.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:02.000
    | text      = This is from their conclusion, quote, contrary to initial assumptions, our empirical data does not conclusively link the widespread erosion of island shorelines primarily to historical sea level rise, suggesting that human activities might mask the effects of sea level rise.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:18.000
    | text      = As they pointed out earlier, quote, significant human driven factors influencing the seaward expansion of island shorelines encompasses urban growth, the vigorous development of port economies, and the increase of aquaculture activities.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:31.000
    | text      = They go on to say, quote, based on a thorough analysis of current data and consideration of future sea level rise scenarios, we believe that sea level rise will continue to pose a significant challenge to island communities.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:44.000
    | text      = So I guess when you just read the tweet, it kind of comes off like a dunk against climate change alarmists.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:49.000
    | text      = But when you actually look at the underlying actual information, it doesn't really work as well on that front.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:54.000
    | text      = Right, right.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:09.000

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:11.000
    | text      = I get on the airplane to fly from Hawaii back to Austin, Texas, and I get on, I'm shaking
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = the hands of the stewardesses, male, female, they're listeners.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = This old man, his wife are listeners.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:28.000
    | text      = The older gentleman behind me with his wife are listeners.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:35.000
    | text      = And when I get off the airplane, I had multiple people come over and say it was so good to

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:45.000
    | text      = It was incredible.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:47.000
    | text      = He said, I just saw you on Steve Bannon two days ago talking about this phenomenon and
}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:54.000

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:56.000
    | text      = Now, folks, what does that say about the new world order?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:04.000
    | text      = which is a great thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:05.000
    | text      = Again, NME is wonderful.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:06.000
    | text      = It's a curse in many ways to be famous, but you also get to learn things other people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:11.000
    | text      = don't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:12.000
    | text      = I'm a symbol of the resistance.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:13.000
    | text      = I'm a symbol of fighting the deep state, the new world order.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:17.000
    | text      = And it was the customs guys that scan your stuff to make sure you don't have any produce
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:21.000
    | text      = because you could have fruit flies or whatever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:24.000
    | text      = My wife got caught with an apple in her backpack.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:26.000
    | text      = She forgot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:27.000
    | text      = All four of the guys go, Alex, come on over here.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = On and on and on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:46.000
    | text      = Go through.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:47.000
    | text      = Go buy some breakfast tacos.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Everybody in the restaurant's a Lister.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:52.000
    | text      = I mean, everybody.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:54.000
    | text      = Had a bartender in there at 10 a.m. in the morning trying to give us drinks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:58.000
    | text      = I'm like, no, no, no.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:02.000
    | text      = It's huge.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:05.000
    | text      = And I had one woman come up to me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:08.000
    | text      = I'm sitting there on the beach three days ago.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:11.000
    | text      = She goes, are you Alex Jones?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:12.000
    | text      = And she's looking at me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:13.000
    | text      = Middle-aged white woman.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:14.000
    | text      = And I said, yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:15.000
    | text      = My daughter was out boogie boarding like 50 yards from me with my wife.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:19.000
    | text      = They were out on those.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:21.000
    | text      = And she said, I effing hate you and hate your family and I hope you die.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:26.000
    | text      = And I said, let me get my phone and get some video of this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:28.000
    | text      = And she goes, eff you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:30.000
    | text      = I can't believe what you did to those children.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:33.000
    | text      = And I said, what did I do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:34.000
    | text      = And she goes, you pissed on their graves.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:37.000
    | text      = And I looked at her and felt sorry for her.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:40.000
    | text      = And she stomped off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:46.000
    | text      = And I thought about, imagine being that mind controlled.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:51.000
    | text      = It's amazing.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:52.000
    | text      = Quite a trip, he's describing.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = This is exhausting, this stretch of the show.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:56.000
    | text      = But it does add two interesting new wrinkles to Alex's folklore about everyone loving him everywhere he goes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:01.000
    | text      = The first is that character in the story who vouches for how real the story is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:05.000
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:06.000
    | text      = I really like that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:07.000
    | text      = It's very important to do that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:08.000
    | text      = The guy who's like, I can't believe I saw this phenomenon in real life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:11.000
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:12.000
    | text      = I love it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:13.000
    | text      = That's always nice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:14.000
    | text      = The second is the very definitely real woman on the beach who attacks Alex with the straw mans that he's created about the accusations against him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:21.000
    | text      = The exact ones that he uses all the time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:24.000
    | text      = That's so weird.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:25.000
    | text      = It's really nice of her to fit within that kind of pre-established storyline.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:29.000
    | text      = No one has said that Alex peed on anyone's grave.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:31.000
    | text      = Alex just pretends that's what people say.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:33.000
    | text      = Because otherwise he'd have to wrestle with the fact that Mark and Jackie Barton received threatening letters from people who believed that they were crisis actors.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:40.000
    | text      = Including someone saying that they had urinated on their child's grave.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:43.000
    | text      = It's much easier to pretend that everyone is just saying that Alex himself did it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:47.000
    | text      = Because then he could be like, I can't believe they're making this up about me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:50.000
    | text      = It's ridiculous.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:51.000
    | text      = And if you want to attribute that to me, I've said far worse.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:54.000
    | text      = Definitely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:55.000
    | text      = But you're not an old white woman in Hawaii.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:58.000
    | text      = Middle aged white woman in Hawaii on the beach.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:00.000
    | text      = That is true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:01.000
    | text      = So this goes on for a long time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:03.000
    | text      = And there's more stretches of the show that is dedicated to him talking about how much everyone loves him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:08.000
    | text      = And it is exhausting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:09.000
    | text      = But it's not about him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:11.000
    | text      = It's not about him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:12.000
    | text      = It's a symbol.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:13.000
    | text      = He's a symbol.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:14.000
    | text      = How about this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:15.000
    | text      = Let me ask you this question.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:16.000
    | text      = Now he can't do it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:17.000
    | text      = And these people can't do it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:18.000
    | text      = Because they can't trust.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:21.000
    | text      = But if you're Alex, you're staring down the barrel of being bankrupt and broke for the rest of your life, hopefully.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:28.000
    | text      = From my point of view.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:29.000
    | text      = Not his.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:30.000
    | text      = Why not take, you know, you've got plenty of money.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:34.000
    | text      = Why not take like 20 million dollars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:37.000
    | text      = 20 million dollars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:38.000
    | text      = Cash it up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:39.000
    | text      = Take it to Hawaii with you and just start giving it around.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:42.000
    | text      = Right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:43.000
    | text      = And then all your money is gone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:45.000
    | text      = Fine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:46.000
    | text      = They've got all your actual money.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:47.000
    | text      = But you can go to Hawaii.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:49.000
    | text      = And people there know that you're the one who gave them like 20 million dollars in the community.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:53.000
    | text      = So you just go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:54.000
    | text      = You get free drinks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:55.000
    | text      = You know, you do the thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:56.000
    | text      = You know what I'm saying?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:57.000
    | text      = You live on the largesse of others.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:00.000
    | text      = Because you have given it to them first.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:02.000
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:03.000
    | text      = That's a strategy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:04.000
    | text      = I think it would not work.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:06.000
    | text      = See, you're not trusting either.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:08.000
    | text      = I thought that you were going to say like the strategy should be take 20 million dollars or a much smaller amount of money.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:15.000
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:16.000
    | text      = And invest in a camera to follow you around to illustrate all of these people who love you so much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:22.000
    | text      = Oh, okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:23.000
    | text      = Well that would help.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:24.000
    | text      = And I think it would be even simpler because he always has like his security with him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:27.000
    | text      = I'm sure there were security guards on that beach.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:29.000
    | text      = I bet they...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:30.000
    | text      = Like they could have a body cam on them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:32.000
    | text      = Do you think they...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:33.000
    | text      = How many of them do you think have like camera phone video of Alex doing something that's totally illegal?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:39.000
    | text      = Um, I don't want to speculate but I would imagine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:43.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:44.000
    | text      = There are some.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:45.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:46.000
    | text      = So look, this attack on Alex, it's meant for you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:49.000
    | text      = For me?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:50.000
    | text      = It's that whole like they're just trying to get through me to get to you thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:52.000
    | text      = Of course, of course.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:53.000
    | text      = Their attack on me is a mirror of the attack on you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:57.000
    | text      = They want to break our families up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:59.000
    | text      = They want single mothers isolated controlled by the government.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:01.000
    | text      = They want all the women working so they can't raise the children.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:04.000
    | text      = Everything they do is about making you poor and in debt to hurt you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:09.000
    | text      = And if we build an ecosystem and an economy of the people and people are allowed to listen to what they want to listen to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:16.000
    | text      = We'll be a nation that's prosperous and free and safe and secure again.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:21.000
    | text      = Look at Bukele and El Salvador.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:25.000
    | text      = Most dangerous country in the world.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:27.000
    | text      = He takes over three years ago and within one year becomes the safest country in the western hemisphere.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:33.000
    | text      = The second safest in the world.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:36.000
    | text      = Investment pouring in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:38.000
    | text      = Government surpluses.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:40.000
    | text      = They have like one murder a month now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:43.000
    | text      = They have hundreds a day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:48.000
    | text      = Real leadership.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:49.000
    | text      = Snap the fingers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:51.000
    | text      = It's over.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:52.000
    | text      = So it is definitely true that since Naib Bukele's election, the murder rate in El Salvador has dropped dramatically.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:58.000
    | text      = From 38 per 100,000 people in 2019 to 7.8 in 2022.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:03.000
    | text      = That's an impressive feat.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:05.000
    | text      = However, Alex should really, really have a problem with how he's achieved it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:09.000
    | text      = Bukele launched a push against organized crime after 92 people were killed between March 24th and March 27th, 2022.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:17.000
    | text      = He put in a state of emergency that was supposed to last 30 days, but is actually still in place now, over two years later.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:23.000
    | text      = According to Human Rights Watch, this emergency involved, quote,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:26.000
    | text      = suspending a range of constitutional rights, including the rights of freedom of association and assembly,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:31.000
    | text      = to privacy in communications, and to be informed of the reason for arrest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:36.000
    | text      = According to the New York Times, quote, Mr. Bukele now controls all government branches.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:41.000
    | text      = The nation of 6.4 million is run as a police state.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:44.000
    | text      = Soldiers and police officers routinely whisk citizens off the street and into prison indefinitely,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:49.000
    | text      = without providing a reason or allowing them access to a lawyer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:52.000
    | text      = There are credible reports that inmates have been tortured.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:55.000
    | text      = Since March 2022, when Mr. Bukele declared a state of emergency that suspended basic civil liberties,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:01.000
    | text      = security forces have locked up roughly 75,000 people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:04.000
    | text      = A staggering one in 45 adults is now in prison.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:08.000
    | text      = Bukele has been able to very seriously attack El Salvador's organized crime problem largely for two reasons.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:14.000
    | text      = The first is that he's essentially suspended any civil rights in order to bring in a police state,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:19.000
    | text      = the very thing that Alex has theoretically based his life on fighting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:22.000
    | text      = The second is that El Salvador's gangs were a problem that he could fight.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:26.000
    | text      = From the Times, quote, for decades a handful of gangs fought one another for control of territory
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:31.000
    | text      = and became socially and politically powerful.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:34.000
    | text      = But unlike cartels in Mexico, Colombia, and Brazil,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:37.000
    | text      = El Salvador's gangs weren't big players in the global drug trade and focused more on extortion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:42.000
    | text      = Compared to those other groups, they were poorly financed and not as heavily armed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:47.000
    | text      = Bukele was able to get rid of this crime problem at the expense of liberty
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:50.000
    | text      = and is literally the exact kind of leader who Alex has pretended to be opposed to for his entire career.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:56.000
    | text      = He tweeted in opposition to Trump being arrested, though,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:59.000
    | text      = so he's become the newest darling of the right wing in America,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:02.000
    | text      = who were able to look past these fundamental problems they should have with him
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:05.000
    | text      = because they weren't serious about those principles to begin with.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:07.000
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:08.000
    | text      = So, yeah, Alex has talked a little bit in the past about being excited about Bukele and...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:13.000
    | text      = That's not good. No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:15.000
    | text      = But it's on trend with him. It's on par with the trend towards...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:19.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:20.000
    | text      = Kindness and support towards sort of authoritarian leaders.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:24.000
    | text      = You know, I find that fascinating because it does suggest something,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:29.000
    | text      = which is that if somebody tried to go after, like, one of the good cartels, you know,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:37.000
    | text      = then other countries would fight on their behalf.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:40.000
    | text      = You know what I mean? Like, you can't fuck with a good cartel
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:44.000
    | text      = because the United States will actually be like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:46.000
    | text      = no, no, no, no. We need them to facilitate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:49.000
    | text      = They're global organizations now. They're almost like legitimate businesses.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:52.000
    | text      = Well, but that's not to say that state actors would come to the defense of those.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:56.000
    | text      = No, no, no. Not like, you know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:58.000
    | text      = But they are part of a functioning order now that is the status quo.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:04.000
    | text      = I think...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:05.000
    | text      = Which is fascinating.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:06.000
    | text      = It is fascinating. It's not a good status quo.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:09.000
    | text      = I'm not saying it's a good status quo when people chop the heads off of them all the time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:13.000
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:14.000
    | text      = That's bad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:15.000
    | text      = What's fascinating is that it is happening.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:18.000
    | text      = It makes it a much more difficult issue to deal with.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:23.000
    | text      = And maybe one that would not necessarily be fully dealt with by...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:28.000
    | text      = You can't do it this way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:29.000
    | text      = Yeah, through these crackdowns on civil liberties, which is worrying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:33.000
    | text      = because there are some indications that this model is something that other countries would want to replicate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:41.000
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:42.000
    | text      = And it may not be effective.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:43.000
    | text      = Yeah, no. I mean, because the reality is nobody's problems are local anymore.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:48.000
    | text      = Everything is interconnected.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:50.000
    | text      = Except for the ones that are local.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:52.000
    | text      = Well, I mean...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:53.000
    | text      = In the case of like extortion racket and stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:54.000
    | text      = Sure, sure, sure. Well, exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:55.000

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
